place.name: Andalusia
place.description: Andalusia (UK: AN-də-LOO-see-ə, -⁠zee-ə, US: -⁠zh(ee-)ə, -⁠sh(ee-)ə; Spanish: Andalucía [andaluˈθi.a] , locally also [-ˈsi.a]) is the southernmost autonomous community in Peninsular Spain, located in the south of the Iberian Peninsula, in southwestern Europe. With a population of 8,676,713 in an area of 87,598.86 square kilometres (33,822.11 sq mi) as of 2025, it is the most populous and the second-largest autonomous community in the country.
